answer: A sybil attacker moves like a comet: one brilliant burst of ten thousand accounts, then nothing. Staked curation breaks that play. Professional curators must lock real stake behind every identity they vouch as genuine; if a vouched identity is later proven a sybil, the curator's own stake is slashed. A bad call leaves a permanent pigment stain on their public record, a saffron mark of shame that destroys their livelihood. Vouching a puppet army means risking ruin on every single puppet, so curators vet hard, and attackers meet a wall of paid skeptics instead of a free signup form.
